correctness.rationale: Exact lumping of equal release rates and positive-diagonal symmetrization give simple strictly negative eigenvalues. A complete exponential zero bound plus positive slow Perron coefficient proves at most floor(m/2) rebounds after initial decline. For m=2 a strict-concavity maximization proves an if-and-only-if condition, including neutral shoulders. The rational two-pool witness has exact initial derivative -1/10 and a positive t=1 derivative certified by a rational Taylor remainder; independent exact t=5 negativity also checked. A standalone artifact reruns both certificates. Limitations: no sharpness claim for every larger m.

value.rationale: Post-emission indoor-air concentration rebound is physically motivated by retained VOC mass on heterogeneous surfaces. The distinct-release-rate obstruction shows why arbitrarily many duplicate rate-class pools cannot generate a false late rebound; the exact two-rate if-and-only-if criterion distinguishes load-dependent rebounds from mere parameter heterogeneity. It is an exact reproducible model diagnostic with limitations: linear first-order coupling, no continued external sources, no empirical calibration or inverse-identification theorem.
